verdict.rationale: Docs describe simple single-command paths to install a skill (`$skill-installer <name>`, `/skills`, `/plugins`) and to scaffold one via `@plugin-creator`, suggesting a fast setup, but no source gives an explicit time-to-first-working-skill benchmark or a hands-on account confirming a sub-five-minute experience. Missing for 10: an explicit quickstart timing claim, a step-by-step first-run walkthrough, and independent/community confirmation that installation actually completes quickly.
